sentiment.label: risk_on
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 16.39 (sotto 18) indica un mercato difensivo limitato, mentre l'S&P 500 è a 7,666.45 (+0.19%) e il DXY a 101.95 (-0.14%) segnala un dollaro debole, favorevole a risk‑on. Il Brent è a $102.01 (-0.29%) e l'oro a $4,217.30 (+0.36%), confermando la propensione verso asset reali. La guerra in corso tra Iran e USA aggiunge un timore inflazionistico (massimo +2 punti), ma il quadro complessivo resta leggermente rialzista.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 16.39 (below 18) points to limited defensive positioning, while the S&P 500 sits at 7,666.45 (+0.19%) and the DXY at 101.95 (-0.14%) reflects a weak dollar, supporting a risk‑on stance. Brent trades at $102.01 (-0.29%) and gold at $4,217.30 (+0.36%), confirming a tilt toward real assets. Ongoing Iran‑US war adds inflationary risk (up to +2 points), yet the overall picture remains mildly bullish.

market_impact_summary.it: Equity US guadagna +0.19% (S&P 500) grazie al dollaro debole (DXY -0.14%) e al VIX in calo (16.39). Il mercato obbligazionario USA vede il TLT a 77.71 (-0.09%) e il rendimento 10Y a 5.23% (-1.06%), segnale di compressione tassi e pressione bearish. Commodities: Brent a $102.01 (-0.29%) riflette un leggero calo del petrolio, mentre l'oro a $4,217.30 (+0.36%) resta stabile, con impatto mixed. La debolezza del dollaro sostiene le valute emergenti e le materie prime.
market_impact_summary.en: US equities rise +0.19% (S&P 500) aided by a weak dollar (DXY -0.14%) and a falling VIX (16.39). US bonds show TLT at 77.71 (-0.09%) and 10Y yield at 5.23% (-1.06%), indicating rate compression and bearish pressure. Commodities: Brent at $102.01 (-0.29%) signals a modest oil dip, while gold at $4,217.30 (+0.36%) stays steady with a mixed impact. Dollar weakness underpins emerging market currencies and commodities.

The European Union and China established a working group in May of this year on "macroeconomic imbalances," but it has failed to produce results so far, and European Commission president Ursula von der Leyen has said that patience is running out.
